Mixing **Zyrtec (cetirizine)** and alcohol is ` [Highlight start] generally not recommended [Highlight end] ` because both depress the central nervous system and can intensify side effects. [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX2QHoOG2dkf6eStisu7oCMuCtH5CETy-FZ_DqorU0s4mKgGRanzO6_pm4dE7QLQL-qlwbzOLvUAIITjs4qhar4YmuOuvwwazz5v5skt_xnwm1jbmGnrQ3tgOJuNmuKAmkX_NDY2NPXP_Y3qaDRPTiuNLssu0) flags this combination as a moderate interaction and advises avoiding or limiting alcohol during treatment.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX2QHoOG2dkf6eStisu7oCMuCtH5CETy-FZ_DqorU0s4mKgGRanzO6_pm4dE7QLQL-qlwbzOLvUAIITjs4qhar4YmuOuvwwazz5v5skt_xnwm1jbmGnrQ3tgOJuNmuKAmkX_NDY2NPXP_Y3qaDRPTiuNLssu0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXPtuT2wnd9y_UPng4AdAq5T3yqChUEUWoG3jpxTyRxe3Zr4m8vnqvGyAW4RTDOJgYULdTnZkG6gCbKuuQSrGof-SdcF9LLkHTZq5ZvnkKARH3ddRPanD_qEEzNfovSE8gfwhYYeYmbJGJ)

### Common Side Effects

Combining them can make everyday side effects stronger, including:

- Drowsiness, fatigue, or heavy sedation
- Dizziness or lightheadedness
- Impaired coordination, balance, and judgment
- Trouble concentrating or blurry vision
- Headaches or dry mouth[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXPtuT2wnd9y_UPng4AdAq5T3yqChUEUWoG3jpxTyRxe3Zr4m8vnqvGyAW4RTDOJgYULdTnZkG6gCbKuuQSrGof-SdcF9LLkHTZq5ZvnkKARH3ddRPanD_qEEzNfovSE8gfwhYYeYmbJGJ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXFJzSUMVpPTz_JIob3PawneMM4jUu6zgjvYL0DTENUyf8c-pw7iHHHMZLTg2vNy6wYOk_qBiI2J1m49Ze53gB4UFfOkncm6l_sr03jm1tTzbFU8GE-eOj7oJaCSRjQT8Nma1YDSfuBh-KRAzbRLSm)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXiJQczvQLZ5XegAQNfTS_gMhpGzPKtiAgRkj582K8i-j4Iq5VBBqgfbisTHhENGNJChJ1pfqEq399SgMZBrpPgywIACRp8vKOAH7AXwk0gQDFfkSXo_duQKXBnwEAgqR1Zvn9Oh7ANhIhZmo5BlI)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX2QHoOG2dkf6eStisu7oCMuCtH5CETy-FZ_DqorU0s4mKgGRanzO6_pm4dE7QLQL-qlwbzOLvUAIITjs4qhar4YmuOuvwwazz5v5skt_xnwm1jbmGnrQ3tgOJuNmuKAmkX_NDY2NPXP_Y3qaDRPTiuNLssu0)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES3AEBxCJF15uCXapE3NosOqo7kps9wCFn1oig4uquJ72Yr1ndBGqXKkk2HhK80cpg9hlPkvmm-jUgWmOteJ4b52ysp0n5tt3nJpfhRHB6iTmdlhnnwXXzRrW9DaPtKHTNNworZVxNmAR4i1QcM-FJZ9-80KqJHkb1SJcsv0TYVt_S04Tv1rQZhsjiruu9lBYXhlDl3toMmdlN6D1LmZNUEH-atonRU9S8ALMcNfDpTI3xGElVlM7SJ0q_zuCLxHVQ6vd_Tp9ccybwNxfSRTcMgZZXTObXGP_yEB4x2oTR)

Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF18HVS0BB69m46jIYYAH301zUxnIOD0yMneW9koaTHEl3G9KixGT_nzexwinMSPr2qf_QGZXefYscKBtfPDBsMwJYlEKmyoAF1V6Z0EoEfkrdhNaYN1hil3AcsK2rGqR0o1_8A3mqb-7b5NJZxSWXcOYAYp6VHivAQfDlTFUxjqoO0DaUJ_-7cs9YUoHERVT62pFmuVyw4lfyPfIl4Q) agree that taking multiple Zyrtec tablets with alcohol can cause extreme drowsiness or knock someone out completely, as the two substances amplify each other's sedating effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF18HVS0BB69m46jIYYAH301zUxnIOD0yMneW9koaTHEl3G9KixGT_nzexwinMSPr2qf_QGZXefYscKBtfPDBsMwJYlEKmyoAF1V6Z0EoEfkrdhNaYN1hil3AcsK2rGqR0o1_8A3mqb-7b5NJZxSWXcOYAYp6VHivAQfDlTFUxjqoO0DaUJ_-7cs9YUoHERVT62pFmuVyw4lfyPfIl4Q)

### Timing and Safety Tips

- **Wait it out:** According to [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF12kPY9eByOHZyuENJn7sP3U2ygVQwwqtoFDfD2rEGbK3DQMw70JYQ1ChETAUPJbDrXko7e6C3DA4Py6fXd1xaZySnW6CDkxJqsfZJCOR_VDqR3VPLuVliA9iE46biyPZTCnCpnoliTGZSbfMsTruhAUSE_ci0QC1T_NoEhL1g2Q4EJcwTw0ExZbgoMZDnnat_PMWw5U0RQ) , Zyrtec takes about 2 days to clear from your body after your last dose, though residual effects can sometimes linger for 1 to 4 days after daily use.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF12kPY9eByOHZyuENJn7sP3U2ygVQwwqtoFDfD2rEGbK3DQMw70JYQ1ChETAUPJbDrXko7e6C3DA4Py6fXd1xaZySnW6CDkxJqsfZJCOR_VDqR3VPLuVliA9iE46biyPZTCnCpnoliTGZSbfMsTruhAUSE_ci0QC1T_NoEhL1g2Q4EJcwTw0ExZbgoMZDnnat_PMWw5U0RQ)
- **Skip driving:** Avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how the combination affects your alertness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX2QHoOG2dkf6eStisu7oCMuCtH5CETy-FZ_DqorU0s4mKgGRanzO6_pm4dE7QLQL-qlwbzOLvUAIITjs4qhar4YmuOuvwwazz5v5skt_xnwm1jbmGnrQ3tgOJuNmuKAmkX_NDY2NPXP_Y3qaDRPTiuNLssu0)
- **Watch the dose:** Do not take more than the recommended dose of Zyrtec, and check with a doctor or pharmacist if you have liver/kidney issues or take other sedating medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES3AEBxCJF15uCXapE3NosOqo7kps9wCFn1oig4uquJ72Yr1ndBGqXKkk2HhK80cpg9hlPkvmm-jUgWmOteJ4b52ysp0n5tt3nJpfhRHB6iTmdlhnnwXXzRrW9DaPtKHTNNworZVxNmAR4i1QcM-FJZ9-80KqJHkb1SJcsv0TYVt_S04Tv1rQZhsjiruu9lBYXhlDl3toMmdlN6D1LmZNUEH-atonRU9S8ALMcNfDpTI3xGElVlM7SJ0q_zuCLxHVQ6vd_Tp9ccybwNxfSRTcMgZZXTObXGP_yEB4x2oTR)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX2QHoOG2dkf6eStisu7oCMuCtH5CETy-FZ_DqorU0s4mKgGRanzO6_pm4dE7QLQL-qlwbzOLvUAIITjs4qhar4YmuOuvwwazz5v5skt_xnwm1jbmGnrQ3tgOJuNmuKAmkX_NDY2NPXP_Y3qaDRPTiuNLssu0)
